source_title: Fans hail ‘Telugu brothers’ Tilak Varma, Nitish Kumar Reddy after India’s Christchurch T20I win - The Hindu
source_excerpt: Fans hail ‘Telugu brothers’ Tilak Varma, Nitish Kumar Reddy after India’s Christchurch T20I win left India's Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy all smiles after winning the second T20I against New Zealand at Christchurch in New Zealand on Saturday. AP AP https://th-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/k7cfnh/article71621318.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/New_Zealand_India_Cricket_35968.jpg JOHN DAVIDSON India's Tilak Varma, left, and Nitish Kumar Reddy pose after winning the second T20 cricket international between New Zealand and India in Christchurch, New Zealand, Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026. (John Davidson/Photosport via AP) VISAKHAPATNAM The ‘Telugu brothers’ tag was trending on social media after Indian batters Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy delivered a brilliant finishing act against New Zealand in the second T20I at Christchurch on Saturday (October 24, 2026) . Their excellent display with the bat triggered a flood of memes, posts and celebratory messages from cricket fans, particularly in the Telugu-speaking States. https://www.thehindu.com/sport/cricket/india-vs-new-zealand-second-t20-international-in-christchurch/article71619286.ece The two cricketers, Tilak from Telangana and Nitish from Andhra Pradesh, became the centre of attention as fans celebrated their contribution to India's performance. Social media users hailed the duo for their composure and finishing skills, with many expressing pride at seeing two Telugu cricketers make their presence felt on the international stage. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/ https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/ Several posts carried the tagline “Telugu brothers destroying New Zealand”, while others celebrated what they described as a memorable moment for Telugu cricket fans. Fans from both States came together online to hail the duo, describing their partnership and finishing efforts as a moment of pride for Telugu cricket enthusiasts. IND vs NZ second T20I: Tilak Varma’s unbeaten 51 fuels India’s four-wicket win in 2nd T20I IND vs NZ second T20I: Tilak Varma’s unbeaten 51 fuels India’s four-wicket win in 2nd T20I Chasing 180, India slipped to 112 for six in the 15th over but Tilak turned the tables on New Zealand, scoring 51 not out off 26 balls with six fours and a six IND vs NZ second T20I: Tilak Varma’s unbeaten 51 fuels India’s four-wicket win in 2nd T20I storyline 1 A video of Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy conversing in Telugu during the innings also went viral. The celebrations continued hours after the match, with Nitish Kumar Reddy joining the online buzz. He shared photographs of himself with Tilak Varma and captioned the post “Saripodha Sanivaram”, borrowing the title of the popular Telugu film. The caption drew an enthusiastic response from fans, who flooded the comments section with jokes, praise and references to the duo's performance. Cricketer Vijay Tripurana, who represents Delhi Capitals in the Indian Premier League, also joined the conversation, commenting “Shiva Tandavame” on Nitish's post. Nitish, who hails from Visakhapatnam, was also given the game changer of the match award. Lokesh showers praise Meanwhile, IT and HRD Minister Nara Lokesh praised the Telugu cricketers. “Telugu cricketers Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy steered Team India from the brink of defeat to victory in the Christchurch T20 against New Zealand. The duo, conversing fluently in beautiful Telugu, coordinated seamlessly to finish the match.
